purpose: Derive every gate shard from the diff, not from a fixed list. A shard exists because a changed crate needs a proof. Unchanged code is already proven by the base run.

change_graph_rule.changed_crates: crates whose sources differ between base and head
change_graph_rule.proof_crates: changed crates plus crates that depend on a changed crate plus crates the changed crates declare as contract-bearing
change_graph_rule.empty_scope: docs or data only: test shards skip, hard gates still run

base_reuse_rule.statement: A test that passed on the base for identical code is already proven and is not re-run.
base_reuse_rule.mechanism: derive_scope publishes base, head, changed_crates and proof_crates; each test shard reads the published scope and exits 0 early when its crate is absent and the scope is non-empty
base_reuse_rule.missing_scope: run the shard: a missing scope file is not a proof of nothing-to-do

cargo_profile_rule.statement: One purpose per profile, one shared target dir.

profiles.release: builds the sovereign CLI once so native verbs run; owned by pool_eligibility
profiles.check: workspace compilation proof; owned by check_compile and always runs
profiles.test: per-crate suite proof; owned by scoped test shards and skipped when the crate is out of scope

cache_effectiveness_rule.statement: Wrapper presence is not wrapper effectiveness.
cache_effectiveness_rule.proof: when the wrapper is configured, sccache --show-stats must report hits plus misses greater than zero after the release build; zero means the gate compiled cold behind a configured wrapper and the step fails
cache_effectiveness_rule.absence: an absent wrapper is not a failure: the host compiles cold, slow but correct. Whether a pool member must carry sccache is declared in infra/registry.json pool.required_tools and enforced by the eligibility verb, never by a shell step
cache_effectiveness_rule.version_pin: wrapper and fleet server stay on one version; skew fails the handshake silently
